name: Necromantic Hold (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a land where necromancy is used to keep your warriors fighting, their fury stopping for none, not even death.

Imperial Training: scything sword

Overloaded Mark: While the mark is active, the target takes a penalty to Strength-based attack and damage rolls equal to 1/4 your emissary level (minimum 1).

Imperial Origin Abilities
Knit Wounds (Sp)

At 1st level, you gain fast healing 1 for 1 minute. The fast healing increases by 1 at 7th and 14th levels. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Heartstopping Pulse (Su)

At 7th level, you gain the ability to channel negative energy as a cleric equal to 1/2 your emissary level. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Death’s Doorstop (Sp)

At 14th level, as a standard action you can touch a creature and remove one negative level.

This ability is usable once per day.
